book.movement: Focus on the opening movement of BOOK.
book.location: Sign near the center of your signing space.

car.framing: Keep both hands in view as if holding a steering wheel.

play.framing: Keep hands below shoulder level and visible.
play.movement: Repeat the playful wrist movement steadily.

finish.movement: Show the finishing outward turn clearly.

open.framing: Keep both hands in the frame.

read.framing: Keep your signing hand and base hand visible.

no.framing: Keep your signing hand close to the camera center.
